name: Walkatrout
abilities: Slippery body - very hard to grab and slides across floors
Can squeeze through cramped spaces such as toilet pipes
Enhanced durability for his size (knocked to the ground with Speedyquick without serious harm)
weaknesses: Tiny - only as tall as a Vaxasaurian's foot - and generally unsuited for combat
summary: A small blue fish on spindly legs whose only real trick is being too slippery to hold - Ben's most reliably useless accidental transformation.
traits: Named by Driba; Ben only starts using the name in An American Benwolf in London
One of four aliens accidentally unlocked by Blukic and Driba in Outbreak
The only Outbreak alien still voiced by Yuri Lowenthal after his debut
Running gag: Ben gets him at the worst possible moments
notableFeats: Slid away from Liam across the Plumber HQ floor (Outbreak)
Reached Bellwood with Speedyquick carrying him (It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 1)
Got into the locked Plumber HQ through the toilet (The Final Countdown)

notableEpisodes: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 1
appearances.designNotes: Small blue fish body with stubby fin arms, shark-like dorsal fin, thin spindly legs, wide underbite mouth, cheek gills and bulging green eyes; green belt strap with the Omnitrix symbol at the front.

image.label: OV
image.notes: Infobox render (1040x1071). The infobox references 'File:20211.png', which is a redirect to 'File:Walky.png' - use the target file name.

scoring.rationale: Practically no combat value: he cannot attack, is the size of a foot, and his one asset is being slippery enough to escape a grip or slide through a pipe. Gills give him a little environmental range. Nearly every use was accidental.

notes: Albedo cannot transform into Walkatrout (Derrick J. Wyatt), although Derrick drew a Negative Walkatrout in 2020.
Whampire's Corrupturas cannot attach to Ickthyperambuloids because of their slippery skin.
Only game appearance is the Reboot-era online game Super Hero Time (excluded).
